examples.japanese: {失敗|しっぱい}の{責任|せきにん}を{取|と}って{降格|こうかく}になった。
examples.english: I was demoted for taking responsibility for the failure.

examples.japanese: {降格|こうかく}すると{給料|きゅうりょう}も{下|さ}がる。
examples.english: When you get demoted, your salary also decreases.

examples.japanese: {降格|こうかく}{処分|しょぶん}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I received a demotion as punishment.

notes:
{降格|こうかく} means moving down to a lower rank or position.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {降格|こうかく}する (to demote)
- {降格|こうかく}になる (to be demoted)
- {降格|こうかく}させる (to demote someone)
- {降格|こうかく}{処分|しょぶん} (demotion as disciplinary action)
- {降格|こうかく}{人事|じんじ} (demotion personnel decision)

USAGE IN SPORTS:
- In sports leagues, {降格|こうかく} refers to relegation to a lower division
- サッカーで{二部|にぶ}に{降格|こうかく}した (was relegated to the second division in soccer)

ANTONYM:
- {昇格|しょうかく} (promotion)
